testsuite.name: Simulate a declined card at capture time and check the error is handled

testcase.name: S1: create_order returns HTTP 2xx
S1: Order id is returned
S1: Order status is valid after create
S1: Order amount matches request
S1: Order currency matches request
S2: capture_order is rejected with a 4xx error
S2: Error body has PayPal 'name' field
S2: PayPal debug_id returned for support tracing (header or body)
S2: Error issue code is INSTRUMENT_DECLINED
S3: create_order is rejected with a 4xx error
S3: Error body has PayPal 'name' field
S3: PayPal debug_id returned for support tracing (header or body)
S3: Error issue code is INSTRUMENT_DECLINED
S4: get_order returns HTTP 2xx
S4: Fetched resource id matches
S5: get_capture returns HTTP 2xx
S5: Fetched resource id matches
S2: Capture-time decline returns INSTRUMENT_DECLINED issue code
S4: Baseline order remains COMPLETED after declined capture attempt
S5: Capture remains COMPLETED and not refunded/reversed after declined attempt

testsuite.system-out:
Tested how a declined card is handled at capture time in the PayPal sandbox. Card orders are charged at create time, so a true capture-time decline was simulated by calling capture_order on an existing order with the INSTRUMENT_DECLINED mock. PayPal rejected it with HTTP 422, issue INSTRUMENT_DECLINED and a debug_id, which is the expected error shape. The create-time decline control (S3) was also rejected with the same 422/INSTRUMENT_DECLINED response. The previously successful order (0AB67962YR4285836) and its capture (16S56782J6857735Y) remained COMPLETED with the original $10.00 amount, so the failed attempt did not corrupt existing state.
[INFO] Declined capture returns a structured, handleable error: S2 returned HTTP 422 UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY with details[0].issue=INSTRUMENT_DECLINED, a description, and a debug_id. The error is machine-readable and includes a support trace id, so the merchant can branch on the issue code and show a decline message. The same error shape appeared on create-time decline (S3).
[INFO] Existing captured order is unaffected by a declined capture attempt: After the declined capture (S2), S4 and S5 show the order and capture still COMPLETED for $10.00 with no refund or reversal. The failed attempt did not change state.
